blends.name: Journey to Godhood + Hatchdragon Emerald Blend

blends.name: Gold + Black Hybrid Egg Blend
blends.desc:
The Gold Dragon Auric had discovered the Golden Dragon Coin contained an essence of draconian melding. By pairing it with a spell of sacrificial blending, a metallic and a dark dragon can form a dragon egg from the aether. This new dragon egg would be filled with strength and a complete soul. 

Auric cast a duplication spell on the treasure which caused it to replicate. The magic was so complex it took two weeks to create a dense enough runic summoning to form mana into a second coin. Pressing the coin to corrupted bitvirus flesh briefly transformed it back to scales but it didn’t hold.

The Golden dragons had decided the remaining elders would supervise the blending and allow their brethren to spawn hatchlings before sending their own souls to the fires of this ancient magic. The final spell has begun weaving its power upon the world. This spell to blend the harsh dichotomoy of black and gold took more power than all the rest. Two full chests of treasure would be needed to complete the spell and birth a new dragon into the world. All exotic dragons have a chance of being born from this hybrid egg.

Blend your dragons and let the next generation be hatched into the world.

The blending of these dragons has the chance to produce a legendary creature of Exotic rarity.
